project_syncer.label: SYNCER
extended_desc: SYNCER is a Chrome extension that syncs playlists between Spotify and YouTube.
It parses each song, applies tokenization, fuzzy matching, and Levenshtein distance to find the best cross-platform match, and handles OAuth authentication via a FastAPI backend.

I built SYNCER for a few reasons; I wanted to keep my playlists updated on multiple platforms with little effort, I wanted to build and deploy a Chrome extension, and I wanted to learn how to use new technologies like FastAPI.
Thus, SYNCER was created!

project_lstm.label: LSTM Stock Predictor
extended_desc: An LSTM model that predicts the next day's closing price of a given selection of stocks, and backtests a simple trading strategy based on the model's predictions.
I had always wanted to build something that utilized neural networks and applied to financial markets since I loved that intersection of ideas, and this was my first foray into it!

project_ss.label: Study Showdown
extended_desc: Study Showdown incentivizes staying on track with studying by tracking the sites each user visits in a given period.
It's comprised of a Chrome Extension that the user interacts with to see their productivity for the session, and a NextJS website that tracks users on a leaderboard.
By staying on studying and productivity-based domains like KhanAcademy, players earn points, and by going on unproductive websites, they lose points.

project_recipelens.label: RecipeLens
extended_desc: RecipeLens is a mobile app designed to help users discover recipes based on available ingredients while accommodating dietary restrictions.
You can take a photo of your ingredients or search them up manually, and the app will return a list of recipes with applied filters for your dietary needs.
We won Best UI/UX at Ignition Hacks 2023, despite none of us having any prior Flutter experience!

project_toygfs.label: ToyGFS
extended_desc: ToyGFS is my implementation of a distributed file system in C, based on Google's 2003 GFS paper. Files are stored across a cluster of servers rather than on a single machine.

A master node coordinates metadata while chunkservers hold the data; every 1MB chunk is replicated across three servers, and the master watches heartbeats to re-replicate chunks whenever a server drops.
Clients move data directly to and from the chunkservers over a custom binary TCP protocol, and an ncurses TUI dashboard visualizes files, chunk locations, and live system events.

project_honck.label: HONCK!
extended_desc: HONCK! is a productivity robot built with a Raspberry Pi and camera, stuffed in a goose plushie!
It takes a snapshot of you in your workspace and analyzes your behaviour via object detection, and makes a honk if it detects you're procrastinating.

I built it at Hack the North 2025, where it placed top 30 out of the whole hackathon. A React Native app talks to a FastAPI backend, while YoloV8 handles object detection and Groq reasons about how productive you're actually being.

experience_vertige.label: Vertige Investment Group
